title: Attending a Weekend Course
paragraphs: Rasyid enrolls in a weekend accounting course to improve his career prospects, giving up his usual Saturday morning routine of sleeping in and relaxing at home with his family.
The first few classes feel challenging, since he has not studied formally in years and struggles to remember the material as quickly as some younger classmates in the same room.

By the fifth week, he starts forming a small study group with two classmates, and explaining concepts to each other after class turns out to help him remember the material far better than studying alone.
By the end of the ten-week course, Rasyid passes the final exam with a solid result. He tells his wife that discomfort at the beginning of learning something new is simply part of the process.
